audit.why: 48.34% over 271 games, TRICKY 7/10. Pillar of Flame reaches 900 against Paddle Star's 800 and Sear reaches 1050, so Brand holds the range; her Sleepy Trouble Bubble on 18s is the one cast that flips a trade.

audit.why: That is Orianna's R. Zoe's R is Portal Jump — an 11/8/5s blink of 575 range that returns her after 1 second. Naming another champion's ultimate is the exact class of error this audit exists to remove.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[1].text and mid around Portal Jump's real behaviour, including that a pillar dropped where she lands catches the return.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said what sleep actually does, and early credited the stun to Conflagration.
audit.why: Riot's text: sleep reduces the target's Magic Resist and the first source of damage that breaks it is doubled — so MR is the wrong purchase and you want a minion to break it, not your own face. Brand's stun is Sear (Q), against an ablaze target only.
audit.corrected: The sleep mechanic now appears in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and dontsFull[0].d; the combo order is restated in early, dosFull[0].d and spikes[0].text. This covers the resistances-invalidated and enemy-dash-deniable entries in _missing.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second' bubble.
audit.why: Sleepy Trouble Bubble is 18/17/16/15/14 and Portal Jump 11/8/5.
audit.corrected: Both fields now carry the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Seventeen fields called Zoe 'he/his' (lint MISGENDER), and spikes[0].text attributed her poke to 'Spell Thief's Edge'.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists zoe as female. Spell Thief's Edge is a support item; her W is Spell Thief, which copies a summoner spell.
audit.corrected: All flagged pronouns corrected and the item/ability confusion removed.

notes: Seventeen MISGENDER findings, the most in my slice. Six of them sit in report[] entries (0, 1, 3, 4, 9, 11). The sweep caps report rewrites at two per matchup, so I made those six PRONOUN-ONLY corrections rather than rewrites — the sentences are otherwise unchanged and the length is identical. Only report[5].t was genuinely rewritten, for the sleep mechanic. Both packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES ('Your Pillar of Flame' and 'Land Sleepy Trouble Bubble' are both correct); the real name errors were elsewhere: 'Command: Shatter' (Orianna's ultimate) in spikes[1].text and 'Spell Thief's Edge' (a support item) in spikes[0].text. Level chart: phases[0..6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[0..6] all read 'Brand' — a pre-existing cross-layer disagreement I could not fix, since the win[N] twins already hold a verdict and no matched pair was writable.
